title: Vanilla+ Crosano Adventure
description: A lightweight and simplified version of the original modpack, focused on Vanilla gameplay with small visual and quality-of-life improvements.
body:
![Crosano's Adventure logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/025ac9e5cee16c707141891fbd434e4b3eb0444b.png)

## About
**Vanilla+ Crosano Adventure** is a Vanilla+ Minecraft modpack focused on adding small visual and quality-of-life improvements while preserving the original gameplay experience.

---

## Purpose
The main purpose of this modpack is to provide a **lightweight, performance-friendly setup** for players who want minimal enhancements without introducing new progression systems or major gameplay changes.

---

## Features
- Near-vanilla gameplay experience  
- Subtle visual improvements using shaders and resource packs  
- Light quality-of-life enhancements  
- Fast loading times and stable performance  

---

## Multiplayer Compatibility
Most mods included in this modpack are **client-side** or have **limited gameplay impact**.  
This allows the modpack to be used on many multiplayer servers, even if the server does not have the same mods installed.

> Some features may be restricted depending on server configuration.

---

## Intended Experience
This modpack is intended for players who want:
- A clean and familiar Vanilla experience  
- Small improvements without altering core mechanics  
- A modpack that feels enhanced, not transformed  

---

## Note
If you are looking for **major gameplay changes** or a **significantly altered core experience**, use the standard version of **Vanilla Crosano Adventure** instead.
